utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard there's a repair drive happening? What's that about?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Honestly, I just got here and haven't heard much yet. What's the repair drive for?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Well, I heard it's a community event where people bring broken items and volunteers help fix them. I was thinking of bringing my broken toaster.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can't wait to get started tomorrow, Opal. I've got all my tools sorted and I'm ready to lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, Mara! Could you tell me your address so I can mark you on the map?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure, it's 42 Cherry Lane.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Noah, I heard about the repair drive. Need any tools from my shed?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Sorry, I was just thinking about something else. What's happening with it?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: It's on Saturday at 9 AM. Folks are fixing things around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday morning works for me. I'll bring my hammer.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I'll bring a screwdriver set. See you at 9 AM near the playground.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: 9 AM near the playground, got it. I'll be there with my hammer.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Kira, I'm excited about the repair drive—I've got a box of spare parts ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, what repair drive? Are you sure we're talking about the same thing?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yeah, the one this weekend! They're fixing up old appliances, and I'm bringing spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No worries, Uli! It's this Saturday at the community center from 10 to 4. You should swing by—maybe we can fix something that's been bugging you?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I'll try to make it! And if you still need tools, I have a wrench set and a hammer I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That's awesome, Ira! Bring 'em along — extra tools are always welcome. See you Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Saturday morning works for me.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Saturday morning? But we still need to confirm the supplies and volunteers are all set. Are we sure that's enough time to prepare?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We can meet Friday evening to confirm everything.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: So Hana, have you thought about what you might bring to the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I haven't decided yet, Jules. Can you tell me more about what the repair drive actually needs?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure, Hana! People bring all sorts of things—broken electronics, torn clothes, wobbly furniture. If it's fixable, we'll try to help. Got anything like that?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Rey! I'm so glad you're here. I wanted to talk about our upcoming repair drive on Saturday morning—do you have a moment?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I have a moment. I've been gathering a few tools but could use more hands.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's wonderful that you've been gathering tools! How about we pair you with a few volunteers to help with setup and running the event?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Uli, are you coming to the repair drive this weekend? We've got plenty of supplies and volunteers ready to go!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, I... I'm not sure yet. I've been dealing with some things at home.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Uli, I'm sorry to hear that. If you need any help or just want to chat, I'm here. But if you can make it, we'd love to have you—there's always a spot for an extra pair of hands!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure, bring your toaster. Do you know what time the drive starts?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: It's at 9am sharp on Saturday. Glad you're coming.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: And where is it being held?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? Yeah, I heard something about that. What's the plan?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Honestly, I'm a bit confused myself. I thought it was a community repair event, but maybe I got the details mixed up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hmm, maybe I misheard too. Could be Faye or Kira know more.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Kira! Have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? We're fixing things at the community center from 10 to 4—bring anything broken!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, a repair drive this Saturday? Are you sure that's actually happening? I haven't seen any flyers.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely! I've been telling everyone—Mara's excited and Uli just heard about it. It's on!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Vik, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. What's the schedule?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, it's this Saturday at the park. We're fixing the broken benches, so bring any tools you have!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I'll see if I can make it. What tools are you short on? I might have a hammer or saw in my garage.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Rey, glad you're here. The repair drive is this Saturday at 9 AM.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, this Saturday at 9 AM? Thanks for letting me know. Where exactly are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We'll meet at my garage, 123 Oak Street. I've got the tools and a list ready.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Faye, do you know what this repair drive is all about? I'm trying to get the details.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, I think it's about fixing the school's router—they're holding a repair drive this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That makes sense. So it's this weekend—do you know where exactly it's being held?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard there's a repair drive happening? What's that about?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Repair drive? I think I heard someone mention it, but I'm not sure what it is exactly.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I think it's a community event where people bring broken items to get them fixed instead of throwing them away. I was thinking of bringing my toaster.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Dane! I'm helping organize a repair drive this weekend—wanna get involved? We're fixing old stuff and teaching skills.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Repair drive? What kind of stuff are we fixing?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, anything really—toasters, lamps, bikes, clothes. If it's broken, we'll try to fix it!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, Leo fixed it? I must've missed that.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Are you sure? I thought we were still waiting on a few things for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hmm, maybe I'm mixing things up. What exactly did Leo fix?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Leo! I'm glad you're here. I'm mapping out drop-off points for the repair drive—could you help me list the addresses of folks who've volunteered?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure. Mine is 123 Elm St. I know the Johnsons at 456 Oak Ave are in.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks Leo! I've got you and the Johnsons. Do you know of any other participants or their addresses?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Maybe I'll stop by if I can... thanks for telling me, Quinn.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No problem, Uli. If you hear any more details about that repair drive, let me know—I'm still trying to piece it together.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I actually heard it's Saturday at the community center, 10 to 4. That's all I know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Mina, have you heard about the repair drive this weekend? We could really use an extra pair of hands!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah, I know it's this weekend. What are the exact times and location?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It's Saturday from 9 AM to 4 PM at the community center on Elm Street. Think you can make it?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! For the park benches, right? Saturday? I think I have a hammer somewhere.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Actually, it's for fixing old appliances, not park benches. I'm bringing spare parts, but we're low on zippers and thread.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, appliances! Sorry, I always mix things up. I still have that hammer, though... do you need it for anything?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Mara, I heard you're helping with the repair drive. Need me to bring any tools from my shed?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's so kind of you, Gus! I think we could use an extra drill and some extension cords. Could you bring those?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mara. I'll bring the drill and extension cords. I'll be there at nine on Saturday.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
